description: Modify a reminder rule; writes audit.

after_seconds.description: new seconds after due for overdue

audience_type.description: new audience: assignees, explicit_users, or assignees_and_explicit_users

filter_source.description: new task filter expression for scheduled rules

offset_seconds.description: new seconds before due for due_before

project.description: project slug in the effective workspace

project_ref.description: new rule project scope; empty clears project scope

repeat_policy.description: new repeat policy: once or every:<duration>

schedule_type.description: new schedule type: daily_at, daily@HH:MM, or cron

schedule_value.description: new daily time such as 08:50, or standard 5-field cron expression

timezone.description: new IANA timezone such as Asia/Shanghai

trigger_type.description: new trigger type: due_before or overdue

workspace.description: workspace slug or UUID; omit to use the actor's default workspace

name: reminder_rule_modify
